regions.today: This morning will be mostly dry with some sunny spells developing. It will turn cloudier through the afternoon as patchy rain and drizzle spreads from the west. Rain will turn more persistent and heavy at times in the evening. Highest temperatures of 18 to 21 degrees in moderate southwesterly winds.
regions.tonight: Tonight will start cloudy with outbreaks of rain and drizzle at first, some turning heavy. The rain will clear eastwards overnight with clear spells and scattered showers following. Lowest temperatures of 11 to 13 degrees in light to moderate west to southwest winds.
regions.tomorrow: Tomorrow will be a bright day with sunny spells and scattered showers. Feeling fresher with highest temperatures of 15 to 18 degrees in moderate westerly winds.
regions.solar_uv: Low to moderate on Monday and Tuesday.
